messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: p99 latency >= 3.5s for service=inference-api (route=/v1/generate) — triggered 6 times in 5m. Escalation level: page primary oncall.

maria: acked — looking now. grabbing traces.

leo: I see the tail spike on eu-west-1 across multiple hosts, p95 also creeping. KV-cache miss rate up ~12%.

maria: timeline? did a rollout land ~10m ago?

leo: small canary of model-server v2.3 pushed 14m ago, but only 5% traffic.

tina: logs show frequent `MODEL_LOAD` warnings and `oom` attempts on a couple pods — suspect sidecar batching backlog.

sam: adding autoscale headroom for inference pool now (kubectl scale --replicas=18 deployment/inference-pool-eu).

maria: good. toggling fallback routing to reduce model size for low-priority routes: `route-policy: fallthrough -> model-llama-quantized` for dev/lowq.

leo: starting prefix cache warmup on eu hosts. hitting `/metrics` shows kv_hit_ratio dropping. warming keys for top 50 prefixes.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation to secondary in 2m (no ack from secondary).

support: opening a customer bulletin draft: "We are investigating increased latency affecting text generation endpoints; some requests may time out. Engineers are mitigating. ETA 30-60m." anyone want to review?

tina: quick check — sidecar memory on pod inference-5 is 95% and OOM killed once. I pushed a restart to that pod to clear stuck batches.

maria: thanks. rollbacks? we can roll the canary back to v2.2 if pressure doesn't drop in 5m.

leo: traffic shifted slightly to dedicated pool (we have reserve), canary still small but the host-level kernel at one node shows high page faults, might be an infra vm-level problem.

sam: opened infra ticket — suspected noisy neighbor on host-43, moving pods off node-43 (cordon + drain).

maria: observed p99 decreased to 2.1s after draining node-43 but still above SLO (1.2s).

leo: enabling temporary batching cap (max_batch_size=8 -> 4) to reduce queue latency. pushing config now.

maria: applied batching cap, seeing immediate p95 improvement. p99 still a little high but trending down.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: page acknowledged by secondary (sam) — escalation halted.

support: updated customer bulletin: "Mitigation in progress; partial relief observed. We'll send another update by 20:30 UTC." :white_check_mark:

tina: we should follow up with a canary rollback in 10m if p99 doesn't go <1.5s. prepping rollback patch.

leo: running a quick grok on traces. Root cause likely combination: host-level memory pressure causing sidecar stalls + canary's small regress in kernel path. Not a model decode bug.

maria: agree. action list: 1) keep draining noisy hosts 2) keep batch cap 3) rollback canary if no convergence 4) finalize customer note.

sam: handing off to night oncall (leo) at +30m. I'll post handoff checklist in 20m.

leo: acknowledged handoff. will monitor for 45m and confirm SLA impact window.

maria: last check: alert noise reduced (incident-bot suppression on until 3378912600), p99 ~1.4s now. leaving channel for postmortem notes.

support: will follow up with customers impacted and include ETA for full root-cause once postmortem is complete.

incident-bot: Incident resolved? No automatic close until metrics stable for 30m.

maria: marking mitigated, leaving for follow-up. thanks team :pray:

summary: Automated PagerDuty page for p99 latency on inference-api. Oncall acked, investigation pointed to host memory pressure + a recent canary.
